Assessor
Assessor
The Lawrence County Assessor's Office maintains property records for all townships. The property record cards contain the assessed value of the property based on the Market Value in use. We also maintain sales information of properties sold for the entire county.
Notice Of Annual Session And Meeting
Pursuant to IC 6-January 1, 2028-6, notice is hereby given to the taxpayers of Lawrence County that the Property Tax Assessment Board of Appeals will meet April 18th, 2024 at 10:00 am, in the Lawrence County Courthouse located at 916 15th Street, Bedford, Indiana, 47421, to reorganize and will continue in session until all business is concluded.
Property Tax Assessment
Real Property
Real Property is assessable on January 1st of each year. Property taxes are paid in the Treasurer's Office on the main floor of the courthouse by May 10th and November 10th. Your taxes are based on the assessed value of your property on January 1st of the prior year.
Business & Farm Tangible Personal Property
Our office will only accept paper copies of the Business or Farm Tangible Personal Property Forms. We will not accept faxes or emailed forms. Forms can be brought in person or mailed to our office at:
Lawrence County Assessor
916 15th Street
Room 25
Bedford, IN 47421
812-275-5405
Personal Property Tax
Personal Property is based on property owned January 1st. Forms are filed annually by May 15th. It is the taxpayer's responsibility to complete the forms.
Personal Property Forms
For Farms please fill out the Form 102 and the Form 104
Business can choose between the Form 103 Short and Form 103 Long please read the criteria at the top of the forms to decide which is the correct form to use. All form 103’s must be accompanied by a form 104.
Supplemental forms and the afore mentioned forms can be found on the DLGF website.
Personal Property Manufactured Homes are also assessable each year on January 1. These homes are assessable and taxable in the same year.
Geographic Information System (GIS)
Lawrence County eGIS is a web based application of land records for property in Lawrence County
You can identify land use, soil id's, surrounding property owners, and search by property owner, address and tax id number, search sales information and print property records / sales information
You can now print a scanned property record card:
Step 1: Click the dot on the GIS map for the parcel
Step 2: Click addition data at the top of the screen
Step 3: Click scanned PRC
